content.content: Šibenik is the third-largest city in the historic region of Dalmatia. Dalmatia is one of the four historical regions of Croatia, alongside Croatia proper, Slavonia and Istria. Šibenik is the oldest native Croatian town on the shores of the sea. Did you know that it has recently become one of the few (around 10) cities in the world with 2 UNESCO sights? St Jacob cathedral and St Nicholas fortress which is being renewed...
